body:
## Outcome

Make the Bloxwap design language a set of actionable human interface rules, not only a component gallery.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Define the visual identity using actual Bloxwap surfaces: dark brand surfaces, green accent, restrained supporting colors, rounded controls, and Bloxwap typography. Specify any approved alternate modes explicitly.
- Define action hierarchy, primary/secondary/destructive versus buy/sell intent, information density for mobile and Pro, progressive disclosure, and platform-appropriate navigation.
- Document interaction states: resting, hover, focus, pressed, selected, loading/busy, disabled, empty, error, success, offline, and stale data.
- Define content rules for labels, validation, confirmation, notifications, terminology, numeric precision, and recoverable errors, with paired do/don't examples.
- State what is shared across platforms and what changes for keyboard, touch, native back, safe areas, and dense desktop layouts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each rule has a concrete example from a Bloxwap product or SDK docs surface and links to the applicable component/pattern.
- [ ] Action precedence and unavailable versus busy behavior are unambiguous; warning/destructive intent is distinct from market direction.
- [ ] Guidelines cover product, marketing, SDK documentation, and native surfaces; examples contain no invented product behavior.
- [ ] The design is explicitly Bloxwap-owned and v1 is bounded by the audited catalog rather than the full upstream shadcn catalog.

## Prerequisites

- #2 — Inventory existing Bloxwap interfaces and define the v1 component catalog

## References

- [Appsite](https://bloxwap.app)
- [Prosite](https://bloxwap.pro)
- [Comsite](https://bloxwap.com)
- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Write the Bloxwap HIG principles and product interaction rules
